topic: 近一年具身感知与导航是否已解决

stopping_rule.note: Stop only when every requirement passes; source-count floors alone never establish coverage.

notes: llm dynamic expansion (high): The static taxonomy has perception and evaluation routes but no dedicated navigation family, so this run adds navigation task families and explicit limitation/deployment surfaces.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-embodied-perception-real-world
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"embodied perception" AND (all:robot OR all:agent) AND (all:real-world OR all:benchmark)
dynamic_suggestions.why: Capture work that evaluates perception as an embodied closed-loop capability rather than an isolated vision metric.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-open-vocabulary-3d-navigation
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:"open-vocabulary" OR all:"open world") AND (all:"3D scene" OR all:"scene graph") AND all:navigation
dynamic_suggestions.why: Cover semantic and geometric scene understanding used by navigation under unseen categories and environments.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-active-perception-navigation
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"active perception" AND (all:navigation OR all:exploration) AND all:robot
dynamic_suggestions.why: Perception in embodied systems is action-dependent; active sensing exposes whether passive perception is sufficient.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-vln-generalization
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:"vision-language navigation" OR all:VLN) AND (all:generalization OR all:robustness OR all:"unseen environment")
dynamic_suggestions.why: Capture recent claims and limits in language-conditioned navigation beyond seen simulators.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-objectgoal-zero-shot
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:"object goal navigation" OR all:ObjectNav) AND (all:"zero-shot" OR all:"open-vocabulary" OR all:generalization)
dynamic_suggestions.why: Cover target-driven navigation with unseen objects and categories.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-navigation-world-model-long-horizon
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"robot navigation" AND (all:"world model" OR all:"video prediction") AND (all:"long horizon" OR all:planning)
dynamic_suggestions.why: Test whether predictive models resolve long-horizon state estimation and planning, or merely improve rollout quality.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-navigation-dynamic-social
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"robot navigation" AND (all:dynamic OR all:social OR all:human-aware) AND (all:real-world OR all:deployment)
dynamic_suggestions.why: Static indoor benchmarks understate navigation difficulty around moving people and changing layouts.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-navigation-sim2real-robustness
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:navigation AND all:robot AND (all:sim2real OR all:"sim-to-real") AND (all:failure OR all:robustness OR all:uncertainty)
dynamic_suggestions.why: Cover transfer gaps hidden by simulator-only evaluation.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-navigation-deployment-recovery
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"mobile robot" AND all:navigation AND (all:deployment OR all:"long-term autonomy" OR all:recovery) AND (all:failure OR all:safety OR all:reliability)
dynamic_suggestions.why: Search for sustained autonomy, recovery, and safety evidence needed to call navigation solved.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-navigation-benchmark-saturation
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:VLN OR all:ObjectNav OR all:"embodied navigation") AND (all:benchmark OR all:evaluation) AND (all:limitation OR all:bias OR all:failure)
dynamic_suggestions.why: Find benchmark critiques and failure analyses that qualify headline scores.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-navigation-real-world-browser
dynamic_suggestions.query: site:arxiv.org/abs ("vision-language navigation" OR ObjectNav) real-world robot failure 2025 2026
dynamic_suggestions.why: Find real-world evaluations and failure analyses if API recall is weak.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-perception-navigation-gap-browser
dynamic_suggestions.query: site:arxiv.org/abs embodied perception navigation benchmark limitation robustness 2025 2026
dynamic_suggestions.why: Calibrate recent vocabulary for unresolved perception-navigation interfaces.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-navigation-calibration
dynamic_suggestions.query: embodied navigation real world benchmark 2025 2026 perception robustness
dynamic_suggestions.why: Calibrate current task names and benchmark terminology.
